EU-China trade talks scheduled for Beijing

The European Union has announced that the next round of trade talks with China will take place in Beijing. Key negotiators from both sides held a call to discuss the upcoming discussions. Brussels is seeking a 'credible' outcome from these talks. The specific dates for the meetings have been set, though they were not detailed in the coverage.
